$comment: Whether a line says your name, shared by tests/main/mentions.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest. Three parts of each client ask this — the notifier, the unread badge and the conversation highlight — and the two clients have to answer identically, or picking up the other device changes what happened while you were away.
$cases: `text` is what somebody said, `nick` is yours, `mentions` is whether it was about you.
